water.name: Land
water.rule: At least 4 of the hex's 7 sample points (centre + 6) fall on OpenStreetMap province or Natural Earth country outlines, unless the centre is sea and the mean elevation is at or below sea level, or at least half its elevation samples are (narrow bays and creeks stay water).

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m (mean depth).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Water hex (most of its 7 sample points off land) with Natural Earth 1:10m lake points that outnumber sea points, or above sea level. The Caspian is drawn as sea.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 85 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation ≥ 260 m, or mean elevation ≥ 2,300 m.

cover.name: None
cover.rule: Water, or no WorldCover land pixels.

cover.name: Broadleaf forest
cover.rule: WorldCover tree cover is the largest group (Iran's Hyrcanian and Zagros forests are broadleaf).

cover.name: Conifer forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and evergreen (42) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and mixed (43) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Scrub & steppe
cover.rule: WorldCover shrubland is the largest group: desert scrub and steppe.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: WorldCover grassland (and moss) is the largest group: mountain pasture and steppe.

cover.name: Pasture
cover.rule: Not used: WorldCover has no separate pasture class (it is in grassland).

cover.name: Cropland
cover.rule: WorldCover cropland is the largest group.

cover.name: Wetland
cover.rule: WorldCover herbaceous wetland plus mangroves is the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: WorldCover built-up is ≥ 30% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Desert
cover.rule: WorldCover bare or sparse vegetation is the largest group: sand, salt flats, rock (the Lut and the Kavir).

cover.name: Ice & snow
cover.rule: WorldCover snow and ice is the largest group.

notes.water: OpenStreetMap province outlines and Natural Earth 1:50m country and 1:10m lake outlines don't meet exactly. A sea hex whose mean elevation is above sea level (and under half of its samples below it) becomes land when at least 4 of its 6 neighbours are land, or when it touches both Iranian and foreign land; it takes the neighbours' majority owner. Narrow reservoirs that cover less than half a hex are land, and their river is drawn through them. Bays stay water when the hex centre is sea and its mean elevation is at or below sea level or at least half of its samples are. A sea hex's elevation is the mean of its samples below sea level (its water depth). The Caspian's surface is about 28 m below sea level, so its shallow north reads as sea, as it should.
notes.relief: From Terrarium elevation samples (~3 km apart, about 25 per hex) with altitude ≥ -100 m, so bays and sea floor don't count; all samples are used if none qualify. Water hexes are always flat.
notes.cover: From ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m), resampled to a ~1 km grid and sampled on a 1 km lattice inside each hex (about 580 points), for every land hex including neighbouring countries. Open water and no-data pixels are ignored; shares are of the remaining land points, rounded to whole percent, and the urban threshold is applied to the rounded built-up share. WorldCover classes are mapped to the usaciv groups listed in each rule.
